contradiction_explanation: The symptoms, endoscopy, diagnosis, and recorded laterality indicate right-sided disease, but imaging shows the abnormality in the left maxillary sinus and clear right-sided sinuses.

clinical_case.symptoms: Persistent right-sided nasal obstruction and pressure over the right cheek.
clinical_case.nasal_endoscopy_findings: Edema and purulent drainage are seen in the right middle meatus; the left nasal cavity is unremarkable.
clinical_case.imaging_findings: CT shows clear right-sided sinuses and partial opacification of the left maxillary sinus.

clinical_case.symptoms: Three weeks of left-sided nasal obstruction, thick nasal drainage, and pressure over the left cheek.
clinical_case.nasal_endoscopy_findings: Edematous mucosa and purulent drainage are present in the left middle meatus; the right nasal cavity is unremarkable.
clinical_case.imaging_findings: CT shows partial opacification of the left maxillary sinus with no significant right-sided sinus disease.
